514	and in the mitzvah of Bikurim it is said "lifnê HaShem Elokecha,"

523	Havayah Elokecha are holy names of the Holy One, blessed

525	still a name of the Holy One, blessed be He.

528	is literally a part of Elokah from above, so when he reaches
